description: Small ViT (192d, 4l, 6h), small predictor (192d, 2l, 6h), batch=32, lr=1.5e-4, wd=0.05
Small ViT (192d, 4l, 6h), cosine LR schedule + 3ep warmup, lr=3e-4, wd=0.1
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but dropout/attn_dropout 0.1→0.3. Tested: stronger regularization via higher dropout to reduce overfitting.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but weight_decay 0.1→0.3. Tested: stronger L2 regularization to constrain weight magnitudes and reduce overfitting.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but added mixup augmentation (alpha=0.8) on patch embeddings. Blend pairs of samples and compute weighted loss from both original and permuted. 3 forward passes per step.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but added Gaussian noise (std=0.1) to patch embeddings during training. Acts as feature-level augmentation to prevent memorization.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but lr 3e-4→1e-4, eta_min 1e-5→1e-6. Tested: slower learning to prevent fitting training noise.
Smaller ViT (128d, 3l, 4h), predictor (128d, 2l, 4h), cosine LR + warmup, lr=3e-4, wd=0.1. Tested: fewer params to reduce overfitting on small dataset.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but dropout/attn_dropout 0.1→0.3 AND weight_decay 0.1→0.3. Tested: combining two regularization methods for compounding effect.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but added CutMix on patches — swap 30% of patches between random pairs in the batch during training. Forces model to use context.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but added gradient clipping (max_norm=1.0). Stabilizes training by capping gradient norms to prevent large updates.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but added EMA (exponential moving average, decay=0.999) of model weights. Uses EMA weights for validation to smooth out training noise.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but mask_ratio 0.75→0.6. Tested: less aggressive masking gives model more visible patches, potentially easier task.
Same as cosine_lr_warmup but MSE loss→L1 loss. L1 is more robust to outliers but may not converge as well for this task.
